QUOTE: "`library/error.c` is generated, not hand-maintained. Both switch bodies are marked "Begin Auto-Generated Code", and `scripts/generate_errors.pl` is documented as "Generate error.c", taking an include dir, a data dir and an output file."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says error.c is generated by scripts/generate_errors.pl, but it never names error.fmt as the template. It says the `.fmt` files couldn't be read and that the generator's inputs are in a "data directory". It also says the headers are the source only loosely, by telling the reader to add entries to a data input.
